newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar to open first stock market in May - official.
newsitem.headline: Qatar to open first stock market in May - official.

text.p: Qatar will on May 10 open the Doha Securities Market (DSM), the Gulf Arab state's first official bourse, a Qatari finance official said on Monday.
Youssef Hussein Kamal, undersecretary at Qatar's Ministry of Finance, Economy and Trade gave the May 10 start-up date during an interview on the sidelines of a gas conference in Doha.
A Qatari newspaper said on Monday 17 Qatari companies would be initially listed on the DSM, which would have a market capitalisation of around five billion Qatari riyals.
Currently the shares of 18 Qatari companies are traded through brokers by telephone on an unofficial stock market.
Qatar signed an agreement with Andersen Consulting Middle East, a unit of the U.S.-based firm, in November to assist in the setting up of an official stock exchange.
The DSM exchange would initially only be partly electronic and participation would be limited to Qatari nationals.
